title: Add operator command registry and capability matrix projection
purpose: Give operators a discoverable terminal-first capability surface without adding runtime authority to agentd.
scope: Define operator command registry entries for capability matrix, plan preview, audit projection, rollback, diagnostics, and support bundle.
Expose blocked prerequisites and optional dependency status.
Keep registry as projection over contracts and config.
Package operator command defaults in rootfs config.
deliverables: operator command registry design or implementation
implementation_steps: Create registry schema and default command entries.
Add command projection for capability availability and blockers.
Ensure registry commands map to semantic entry points or projections.
Record evidence with sample JSON output.
acceptance_criteria: Each command has risk, owner, semantic mapping, and blocked prerequisites.
Operator can see local-only versus optional integration status.
verification: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/validate-alpha-rootfs.ps1 if packaging changes
failure_modes: Command registry grants authority instead of projecting status.

blocked_until: Operator registry exists or is fully specified.
